BiblicalUsage: The border of Judah was drawn out from Mount Seir to the border of Ekron, and the carpenter stretches out his rule and marks his idol with a line. The word is to delineate, to draw in outline. It appears in boundary lists and in the workshop of the idol-maker, the same hand drawing a line for two very different purposes.
TheologicalSignificance: Here is the lesson, as I see it: God draws the lines of His people's land, and men draw the lines of gods they have made, and only one of them stands.
